priorityList: Maintain Virulent Plague with Outbreak if it has fewer than 3 ticks remaining.
Cast Army of the Dead if you have at least 30 Runic Power or the Festering Scythe debuff is active.
Cast Dark Transformation if Army of the Dead is active or if Army's cooldown is greater than 30 seconds.
Use Soul Reaper on targets below 35% health.
Cast Death and Decay (or Desecrate) if it is not currently active on the ground.
If talented into Festering Scythe, cast Festering Strike to maintain the Festering Scythe buff and debuff.
Cast Epidemic if you are at risk of capping Runic Power, have a Sudden Doom proc, or have fewer than 2 Runes available.
Cast Festering Strike if you have 0 stacks of the Lesser Ghoul Ready buff.
Cast Scourge Strike if you have 1 or more stacks of the Lesser Ghoul Ready buff.
Cast Putrefy whenever available, especially if you have max charges or Dark Transformation is active.
Cast Epidemic as your primary Runic Power spender in AoE situations.
Use offensive trinkets and potions when major cooldowns like Dark Transformation or Army of the Dead are active.
Use damage-increasing racial abilities (such as Blood Fury or Berserking) while Dark Transformation is active.
Use utility racials (like Arcane Torrent or Bag of Tricks) if you are low on both Runic Power and Runes.
